prompt: In a bustling alien marketplace on a desert planet, a tall, three-eyed alien merchant with green skin is standing behind a market stall. The stall has an awning made of strange fabric. The merchant, who is taller than the human astronaut, is holding up a glowing, floating crystal and showing it to a human astronaut in a bulky white spacesuit. The astronaut is pointing a scanner device at the crystal. The market stall is between the merchant and the astronaut. On the stall, there is a cage to the left of a pile of bizarre-looking purple fruits. The cage contains two small, furry, six-legged creatures. The number of purple fruits is twice the number of creatures in the cage. Also on the stall are some metallic coins, and their number is one more than the number of purple fruits. The floating crystal is larger than the cage on the stall. The astronaut is standing closer to the stall than a larger, different alien who is walking behind the astronaut. The merchant is using one of its three hands to push the pile of fruit towards the astronaut. The astronaut has a helmet with a reflective visor.
